table.source: DexGraspNet 2.0 paper and supplement: objects are placed within an approximately 30 cm x 50 cm tabletop/area. The 2 cm thickness and tabletop-centred world origin are adapter conventions.

camera.pose_source: open-source GraspNet scene_0000/realsense: T_table_camera = cam0_wrt_table @ camera_poses[index]

camera.placement_note: Official rotations are retained. Translation is fitted along each optical axis so the centred 0.50 x 0.30 x 0.20 m tabletop workspace remains visible with a 5 percent image border.

workspace.sampling: Match src/utils/pc.py:get_workspace_mask: transform visible object points to world/table coordinates, expand their axis-aligned bounds by 0.02 m, retain finite depth points in the box, then sample with replacement exactly as official dataset.py.

physics_acceptance.pipeline: analytic_stable_pose_packing candidate -> Isaac Sim 5.0 stability filter

candidate_generation_config.source: The validated 40-scene Trimesh stable-pose, six-object random-anchor footprint-packing and Isaac Sim stability pipeline is reused. The final 40 analytic candidates add an explicitly recorded upright-pose bias requested after visual inspection; all poses still come from the Trimesh stable-pose library and require Isaac Sim acceptance.

upright_pose_bias.policy: Candidates 0000-0119 retain probability-weighted stable-pose sampling. Candidates 0120-0159 contain at least two objects forced to a tall Trimesh-stable pose. Upright means height >= 80% of that object's tallest stable orientation, height/max(XY span) >= 0.8, and tallest/shortest stable height >= 1.25. Forced poses remain probability-weighted within the qualifying subset and must pass unchanged Isaac Sim physical acceptance.

source_ledger.table: DexGraspNet 2.0 paper and supplement: objects are placed within an approximately 30 cm x 50 cm tabletop/area. The 2 cm thickness and tabletop-centred world origin are adapter conventions.
source_ledger.candidate_sampling: Adapter method: Trimesh 4.12.2 compute_stable_poses provides quasi-static support poses; Shapely 2D convex footprints are packed inside the paper-sized tabletop. This is not the unreleased modified DREDS generator.
source_ledger.scene_generation: The validated 40-scene Trimesh stable-pose, six-object random-anchor footprint-packing and Isaac Sim stability pipeline is reused. The final 40 analytic candidates add an explicitly recorded upright-pose bias requested after visual inspection; all poses still come from the Trimesh stable-pose library and require Isaac Sim acceptance.
source_ledger.physics: mass=0.1 kg and friction=0.2 follow DexGraspNet 2.0 evaluation settings; solver/contact details are adapter values
source_ledger.stability: Adapter acceptance contract. Analytic candidates start 1 mm above their stable support plane. Isaac allows up to 2 s for settling, records the velocity-quiet diagnostic, and then accepts only if every object moves at most 2 mm and rotates at most 2 degrees over a separate 1 s observation. Exact mesh vertices must remain inside the tabletop and no more than 3 mm below its contact plane. Exact scene-stability thresholds are not published.
source_ledger.camera_pose: open-source GraspNet scene_0000/realsense: T_table_camera = cam0_wrt_table @ camera_poses[index]
source_ledger.camera_intrinsics: open-source GraspNet scene_0000/realsense/camK.npy, converted to Isaac/Omniverse's supported pinhole form by averaging fx/fy and centering cx/cy

dataset_derivation.policy: Exact scene and camera tensors copied; only downstream grasp labels are recomputed.
